ex.s: And in contrast to our increasingly networked lives where the information we consume is monitored and tracked, a printed book still offers the chance of a wholly private, “off-line” activity.

ex.s: Naming each nature experience creates a usable language, which helps people recognize and take part in the activities that are most satisfying and meaningful to them.

ex.s: All camp sessions are created with age-appropriate activities that are tailored to the multiple ways that kids learn.
ex.t: 所有营期都按年龄设计合适的活动，针对孩子多种学习方式量身定制。

ex.s: Class activities will vary from day to day, but students must be ready to complete short in-class writings or tests drawn directly from assigned readings or notes from the previous class' lecture/discussion, so it is important to take careful notes during class.
ex.t: 课堂活动每天不同，但学生必须准备好完成直接取自指定阅读或上节课讲座/讨论笔记的简短课堂写作或测试，所以课堂上认真记笔记很重要。

ex.s: I’m enjoying the creative activities, and it feels great to have done something useful.”

ex.s: It would work like this: An officer arriving at the scene of a crash could ask for the phones of the drivers and use the Textalyzer to check in the operating system for recent activity.

ex.s: Combine your activities.

ex.s: A new exhibition in Halifax uses everyday activities to explain the hidden math principles we all use on a regular basis.

ex.t: 大多数博物馆也欢迎学生团体，并为孩子们安排特别活动。

ex.s: Exhibitions, events and family activities throughout the year.
ex.t: 全年的展览、活动和家庭活动。

ex.s: The researchers analyzed video recordings of 53 child-parent pairs during everyday activities at home and found children who play with puzzles between 26 and 46 months of age have better spatial skills when assessed at 54 months of age.
ex.t: 研究者分析了53对亲子在家日常活动中的录像，发现26至46个月大时玩拼图的孩子，在54个月大评估时空间技能更好。

ex.s: There are usually no planned activities like games at a housewarming party.
ex.t: 乔迁派对通常没有像游戏这样安排好的活动。

ex.s: For those who can stomach it, working out before breakfast may be more beneficial for health than eating first, according to a study of meal timing and physical activity.
ex.t: 根据一项关于进餐时间与身体活动的研究，对那些能承受的人来说，早餐前锻炼可能比先吃饭更有益健康。

ex.s: I don't know what made me decide to try some new activities at the new school, but one day I chanced to show up for an after-school meeting of the Science Olympiad team.
ex.t: 我不知道是什么让我决定在新学校尝试一些新活动，但有一天我碰巧去参加了科学奥林匹克队的一次课后会议。

ex.s: The activity attracted various people.
ex.t: 该活动吸引了各种各样的人。

ex.s: And unplanned human activities have proved the idea of top﹣down control by top predators to be true． In the ocean， we fished for top predators such as cod on an industrial scale， while on land， we killed off large predators such as wolves． These actions have greatly affected the ecological balance．
ex.t: 而人类无计划的活动已经证明了顶级捕食者自上而下控制的观点是正确的。在海洋中，我们以工业规模捕捞鳕鱼等顶级捕食者，而在陆地上，我们消灭了狼等大型捕食者。这些行为极大地影响了生态平衡。

ex.s: Uncontrolled human activities greatly upset ecosystems．
ex.t: A．失控的人类活动极大扰乱生态系统。

ex.s: Industrial activities help keep food webs stable．
ex.t: D．工业活动有助于保持食物网稳定。

ex.t: 学生应和家长/监护人一起阅读清单，并选择两项他们想做的活动。

ex.s: This makes a fun activity for a children’s party; they love feeding the fruit and frozen bananas into the top of the machine and watching the ice cream come out below.
ex.t: 这对儿童派对来说是个有趣的活动；他们喜欢把水果和冷冻香蕉从机器顶端投入，看着冰淇淋从下方出来。

ex.s: Children’s after-class activities.
ex.t: 孩子的课后活动。

ex.s: Some of us were confident and eager take part in the class activity, others were nervous and anxious.
ex.t: 我们中有些人自信而渴望参加班级活动，其他人则紧张焦虑。

ex.s: More than 23 percent of adults and 80 percent of adolescents don't get enough physical activity, and according to a 2019 report from the World Health Organization.
ex.t: 超过23%的成年人和80%的青少年缺乏足够的身体活动，根据世界卫生组织2019年的一份报告。

ex.s: These activities involve goal management and planning along with the ability to focus while competing on a team.
ex.t: 这些活动涉及目标管理和规划，以及在团队竞争中专注的能力。

ex.s: Don’t forget to stop by Pacific Science Center’s Store while you are here to pick up a wonderful science activity or remember your visit.

ex.s: She says these activities at bedtime can get kids all excited and make it hard for them to calm down and sleep.
ex.t: 她说这些睡前活动会让孩子兴奋起来，使他们很难平静下来入睡。

ex.s: Activities to prevent sleeplessness.
ex.t: 青少年与睡眠相关的疾病。

ex.s: So they have a ＂God’s eye view＂ of activities in their own markets and beyond.

ex.s: Taking part in community activities.
ex.t: 参与社区活动。

ex.s: Sadly, human activity is the main reason why the number of monarch butterflies is falling.
ex.t: 可悲的是，人类活动是帝王蝶数量下降的主要原因。

defs.def: a thing that you do for interest or pleasure, or in order to achieve a particular aim （为兴趣、娱乐或达到一定目的而进行的）活动

ex.s: After-school activities also play a part when students apply to college.
ex.t: 课后活动在学生申请上大学时也起到一定的作用.

ex.s: Join us for TransForm, the interactive summer camp that helps you teens find your passion by participating in various activities and connecting with others.
ex.t: 加入我们的TransForm吧，这是一个互动夏令营，通过参与各种活动并与他人建立联系，帮助青少年找到自己的热情。

ex.s: We look forward to welcoming you as we showcase the creativity of the Harvard arts community through performances, art exhibitions and art-making activities.
ex.t: 我们期待欢迎你，通过表演、艺术展览和创作活动展示哈佛艺术社区的创造力。

ex.s: It presents recreational activities.
ex.t: 它提供娱乐活动。

ex.s: The fun part of the activities is that the kids can eat or take home whatever they make.
ex.t: 活动的有趣之处在于，孩子们可以吃掉或带回家他们做的任何东西。

ex.s: This process requires you to step away from optional online activities for thirty days.
ex.t: 这个过程要求你远离可选的线上活动三十天。

ex.s: At the end of the thirty days, you will then add back a small number of carefully chosen online activities that you believe will provide massive benefits to the things you value.
ex.t: 在这三十天结束时，你再重新加入少量精心挑选的线上活动，这些活动你认为会为你所看重的事物带来巨大益处。

ex.s: Explorers Camp organizes engaging arts, history and science-related activities in every! class, and focuses on a range of topics that emphasize active learning, exploration and, most of all, fun!
